protocol.choice_scope: Constant per-channel weights,never target/error-specific experts;no model refit or new labels
protocol.assessment: Already-viewed original assessment,read only after channel choice seal;regression only
protocol.future_scope: Fixed before channel choice/new policy evaluation;other past public studies possible,not final/private

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

paired_day_diagnostic.note: Day-mean diagnostic, not a confidence interval for Kaggle score.

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limits: Cal used for development/choice;original assessment viewed. Per-channel combination may change q/v dynamics;legacy increment proxy not formal Physics. No hidden-label inference.
